core_obligations: Encode a Boolean Multilayer HPC instance in a layered graph with controlled target degrees.
Retain all six author diagrams, peeling invariants and the complete auxiliary-node completion proof.
Simulate each streaming pass by two communication phases to transfer the optimal MultiHPC lower bound.
difficulty_reason: The authors build a degree-controlled layered gadget that turns hidden-pointer parity into a degeneracy threshold, maintain a detailed peeling invariant, and simulate streaming passes in a misaligned communication protocol. The full source-local information lower bound and deferred graph completion are retained.

Distinct from pure communication lower bounds and the independent communication upper bound.

compared.difference: Uses MultiHPC lower bound but adds a new graph encoding, auxiliary degree completion, peeling invariant and streaming simulation.
